Subject: GST exemption - what evidence do you need to stop auto-charges?

Hi Ben,

We reviewed last month's invoices and noticed GST was being applied even though Greenleaf has a registered GST number in India and believes many of the monthly usage charges qualify for an exemption under reverse-charge rules. Can you confirm what documentation your finance team needs (GST registration, signed exemption form, PO), and whether we can stop auto-charges until this is resolved? Our AP team is trying to avoid unnecessary refunds and manual credits.

Attached is our GST registration snapshot (attached as a PDF) — I can also route a signed exemption form if needed.

Thanks,
Anita

Greenleaf Retail

Subject: Re: GST exemption - what evidence do you need to stop auto-charges?

Hi Anita — thanks for the note and the certificate. Quick answers up-front:

- To evaluate exemption under India GST reverse-charge we need (1) your GSTIN (we have it in the PDF but please confirm), (2) a signed exemption request form from an authorized signatory, and (3) the PO/contract or a reference to the purchase reason for our records.
- We can temporarily pause auto-charges for the invoice cycle once compliance has confirmed the documents, but finance will need to run a validation and we may need to issue a credit for the last charged period if exemption applies retroactively.

I'm looping in Evelyn from our billing team to confirm the exact checklist and the dunning/update sequence so AP doesn't get duplicate notices while this is processed. Can you confirm the GSTIN and the name on the tax registration exactly as it appears on invoices? Also, please provide the authorized signatory name for the signed form.

Next steps:
1) Anita: reply with GSTIN + signatory name and attach signed-exemption-request.pdf
2) Evelyn: confirm checklist and whether we can pause the payment gateway for one billing cycle and the timeline for credits (if any)

Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi all — thanks for looping me in. I'm on the billing side; below is the standard checklist we need to accept a GST exemption and how we'll handle dunning while it's pending:

Checklist (please provide):
- Copy of GST registration (GSTIN clearly visible) — we received Greenleaf_GST_certificate.pdf but please confirm the GSTIN string in your reply.
- Signed exemption request on company letterhead (signed-exemption-request.pdf).
- Purchase order number or contract clause referencing taxation treatment (if available).
- Confirmation whether invoices should be issued without tax for future billing or whether we should issue invoices and apply an offsetting credit (state preference).

Dunning & auto-charge handling (proposed):
- Stage 1: Pause pre-authorization/auto-charge on upcoming invoice cycle once we have the signed form and GSTIN verified.
- Stage 2: Hold dunning for 14 days (no automated reminders) while we perform tax validation. This prevents duplicate AP escalations.
- Stage 3: If exemption applies retroactively, issue a credit for the last charged cycle and reverse the charge. Credits typically take 5–7 business days to reflect.
- Stage 4: If incomplete docs after 14 days, resume normal dunning and auto-charge; finance will notify AP first.

I've attached a suggested dunning sequence spreadsheet (proposed-dunning-sequence.xlsx) with exact days and notification templates — happy to adjust based on your AP flow.

If you confirm the GSTIN here and attach the signed-exemption-request.pdf, I'll kick off the validation with our tax partner and block auto-charge for the next invoice run.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Manager, Billing Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-dunning-sequence.xlsx
